original_P10_33.scope: Separate historical scopes. All old bytes remain unchanged.

reuse.early_refusals: Three feedback cases retain their old pins. They refuse before E construction.
reuse.execution_drift: The completed focused execution-drift case retains its old pins. It refuses before E admission.
reuse.ordinary_direct_host: The two compatibility file receipts retain their old pins. No issued owner exists.
reuse.probe: Five completed probe XML cases retain their old pins. No issued owner exists.
reuse.settled_eleven_and_eight: The later corrections add frame/method identity checks and pre-callback partial-proof retention. Existing original guards, bounds, data stages, route/capability checks, control objects and partial charges remain intact. Their earlier exact pins remain attached. No old scope becomes a new aggregate.
